ART.scope: Models, rigs, animations, environment kit, materials, visual effects assets, optimized GLB delivery. Gameplay programming and final Godot scene integration belong to the programmers.

NET.scope: ENet sessions, discovery, synchronization, network validation, match transitions, Windows exports and release integration.

UI.scope: Menus, HUD, controls, settings, question runtime, question editor and local persistence. Works against the gameplay and network interfaces.
